defense_in_depth_findings.disposition: Coordinator validation is mandatory before either child starts; direct secondary hardening is bound to the next reader generation and does not weaken this event boundary.
All 1410 bound requests independently satisfy geometry and block divisibility; add direct secondary checks at the next reader generation for localization, not acceptance safety.
Set equality and FAIL/REJECT scanning enforce the underlying invariants; rename hardcoded summary predicates at the next schema generation so they cannot be mistaken for observed counters.

Route structure and full logits are acceptance gates; per-layer hashes are diagnostic surfaces. A future post-event comparator may add frozen per-layer numeric bounds without changing this pre-access contract.
The qualification output, implementation head, source tree, and exact-head CI are committed and reproducible; bind the qualifier source directly in the next scientific-access contract generation.
The event contract and validator pin position zero where either lane convention is identity. Any future nonzero-position reuse is prohibited until RoPE semantics are separately resolved and reviewed.
